Light Attacks cost 2.5% Super Energy and deal <pve 864 /> <pvp [?] /> damage up to 8 meters away, whether grounded or airborne. Grounded Light Attacks can be chained into a 3-hit combo.

Grounded Heavy Attacks cost 8% Super Energy and deal <pve 1,264 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in an approximately 45° cone reaching 8 meters ahead. Finishing a Light-Light-Heavy combo instead performs a Palm Strike, dealing <pve 2,950 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and <arc Blinding /> enemies in the same area.

Airborne Heavy Attacks cost 8%? Super Energy, deal <pve 1,264 /> <pvp [?] /> damage, and <arc Blind /> enemies.

Guarding drains an additional ?% Super Energy per second and fully blocks and reflects attacks in a 180?° angle. Each reflected attack grants a stack of <arc Bolt Charge />. Reflected projectiles are redirected toward your reticle and deal 100% increased damage against PvE Combatants.

Your Class Ability performs an evasive dodge that costs no Super Energy and grants <pve ?% /> <pvp [?%] /> Damage Resistance during the dodge. Equipping <arc Ascension /> allows repeated uses during the Super at a cost of ?% Super Energy each.
